metadataContract: TypeScript contracts generated from WindowContract, TabContract, FieldContract, ReferenceInfo, FieldGroupContract
Frontend consumes API responses against strict types
Contract tests verify JSON wire format matches TypeScript shapes
genericForms: Dynamic form renders from SysWindow/SysTab/SysField metadata
ControlType maps to appropriate React Hook Form field
Validation pipeline: mandatory → type → length → reference → valrule
Form submit calls POST/PUT endpoints (501 removed, functional in Phase 5+ or via backend CRUD)
genericGrids: Data grid renders columns from SysField metadata
Pagination, sorting, filtering via Data API query builder
Filter DSL passed as JSON AST to API
lookupSearch: LIST/TABLE/SEARCH reference types resolved via Lookup API
Redis cache integration for lookup results
fieldGroups: SysFieldGroup rendered as collapsible field sections in forms

e2e: Full form create → save → display flow
Menu navigation → window metadata fetch → form render
